scope: module-wide syntax-only classification of open finite formal-conjectures declarations
upstream: the one exact commit and root tree resolved by the P0-frozen upstream-ref rule
permitted_inputs: outer conclusion relation and proposition syntax
forbidden_inputs: candidate, proof route, residual, family, or benchmark rank

domain_signals.graph: SimpleGraph appears in a binder type or the declaration is under an exact graph-domain module namespace
domain_signals.algebra: finite carrier plus operation/equational syntax under an algebraic namespace
domain_signals.process: finite state, transition, word, game, machine, or process syntax under an exact process-domain namespace
domain_signals.combinatorial: finite-set, family, coloring, partition, tableau, design, or discrete configuration syntax not assigned earlier

finite_signal: Fintype/Finite/Finset/cardinality or an explicitly finite encoded carrier is required for the three nongraph strata
graph_scalar_signal: after removing binders and top-level hypotheses, the outer conclusion is an ordered equality/inequality between scalar-valued graph expressions
declaration_rule: Assign in precedence GRAPH_SCALAR_INEQUALITY, GRAPH_STRUCTURAL_PROPERTY, FINITE_ALGEBRA_EQUATIONAL, AUTOMATA_GAME_PROCESS, FINITE_COMBINATORIAL; otherwise AMBIGUOUS_EXCLUDED.
cluster_rule: Every declaration in a conservative question cluster must receive the same eligible stratum; disagreement or unresolved siblings exclude the cluster.
output_policy: emit identities, syntax flags, stratum, ambiguity reason and hashes only; never statement text, ranking, selection, or semantic analysis
